cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your shelf fell because they sent the wrong bracket. Remember when I taught you to inspect the parts before blaming your hands?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You fitted it upside down. Look at the arrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're finally using the markings. That's a misleading arrow. Photograph it for the manufacturer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You drew that arrow. I watched you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because theirs was missing. Don't stop at the first thing you notice; I taught you better than that. Put their missing safety mark in the complaint.

reason: Use the exact Stance as a method of pursuing this Drive rather than a prefixed reminder. Repair missing interaction details or stalled progression explicitly; preserve distinct alternatives and spoken partner contributions.
